atoms.a: How does Rocco feel about what Poppy said?

feedback.end: That’s right, Rocco is feeling sad. Poppy hurt his feelings by telling him his fur is too soft.

atoms.text:
Sadness can be hard to feel, and many people try not to be sad. But sadness is natural and can be a helpful emotion.

People feel sad when people hurt their feelings, when something doesn’t happen the way they want it to, or when a loved one is sick, hurt or maybe even dying.

instruction.text: Find different parts of Rocco to see how he and others can experience sadness.

feedback.end: Crying is a normal response to feeling sad. Tears help free emotions so that they’re not stuck inside. Girls and boys, men and women — everyone cries.
Folding your arms, hugging yourself, or covering your head with your hands are all normal responses to sadness. When you’re sad, you just need a big hug. Sometimes, you can give that to yourself.
Like most other emotions, sadness is also a feeling in your tummy. Some people’s tummies hurt or feel upset when they’re sad. They can also feel heavy or too light.
Before you cry, your throat can feel tight and clogged. The tears can feel like they’re stuck, as if there’s an apple there.
Legs can feel weak when you’re sad, like you need to sit down and just stop moving for a moment.

atoms.text:
Sadness can be hard to feel, but it’s always important that you do. Every emotion is important and tells you something you need to know.

Rocco was sad because his feelings were hurt. He should talk with Poppy and tell her she hurt his feelings. When was the last time you were sad and needed to cry?
